```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(haven)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(scales)

efcu <- read_sav("../data/Case_31_Data_efcu_1.sav") |>
  zap_labels() |>
  mutate(
    residence = if_else(q38 == 1, "Headquarters", "Non-headquarters"),
    at_emp = rowMeans(across(q3:q6))   # employee proficiency (mean of q3-q6)
  )

# Theme colors, shared with dashboard.scss
theme_teal  <- "#1f5f5b"
theme_coral <- "#c8553d"
theme_sand  <- "#d9c9a3"

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 18))
```

```{r}
#| label: values
n_members   <- nrow(efcu)
emp_mean    <- mean(efcu$at_emp)
pct_good    <- mean(efcu$q37 %in% c(1, 2))           # Excellent or Good
pct_loan    <- mean(efcu$q27 == 1)                    # currently have a loan
pct_hq      <- mean(efcu$q38 == 1)
```

# Members & Employees

## Sidebar {.sidebar}

**About the data**

Mail survey of Employees Federal Credit Union (EFCU) members, from Case 31.

- 300 members sampled
- `r n_members` responses analyzed
- `r percent(pct_hq, 0.1)` live in the headquarters area

**Scales**

Agreement items: 1 = Strongly Disagree to 5 = Strongly Agree.

Employee proficiency is the mean of four items (q3–q6).

## Row {height="22%"}

::: {.valuebox icon="people-fill" color="#e8f1f0"}
Members surveyed

`r n_members`
:::

::: {.valuebox icon="person-badge" color="#f6e3dd"}
Employee proficiency (out of 5)

`r number(emp_mean, 0.01)`
:::

::: {.valuebox icon="star-fill" color="#efe7d3"}
Rate the CU Excellent or Good

`r percent(pct_good, 1)`
:::

::: {.valuebox icon="cash-coin" color="#e8f1f0"}
Currently have a CU loan

`r percent(pct_loan, 1)`
:::

## Row {height="78%"}

### Column {width="55%"}

```{r}
#| title: How members rate employees
#| fig-asp: 0.55
emp_items <- efcu |>
  select(Courteous = q3, Helpful = q4, Professional = q5, Available = q6) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "item", values_to = "score")

emp_items |>
  group_by(item) |>
  summarise(mean = mean(score)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = mean, y = fct_reorder(item, mean))) +
  geom_col(fill = theme_teal, width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = number(mean, 0.01)), hjust = -0.2) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 5), breaks = 1:5) +
  labs(x = "Mean agreement (1-5)", y = NULL)
```

### Column {width="45%"}

```{r}
#| title: Employee proficiency by residence
#| fig-asp: 0.75
ggplot(efcu, aes(x = residence, y = at_emp, fill = residence)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, color = "grey30") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Headquarters = theme_teal,
                               `Non-headquarters` = theme_sand)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Employee proficiency (1-5)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

# Services & Operations

## Row {height="55%"}

```{r}
#| title: Awareness and use of CU services
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5
services <- c(
  q13 = "Regular share account", q14 = "Special subaccounts",
  q15 = "Christmas club account", q16 = "IRA",
  q17 = "Master credit card", q18 = "Signature loans",
  q19 = "New car loans", q20 = "Late model car loans",
  q21 = "Older model car loans", q22 = "Household goods loans",
  q23 = "Recreational loans", q24 = "Share collateralized loan",
  q25 = "IRA loans", q26 = "Line of credit loans"
)

awareness <- efcu |>
  select(all_of(names(services))) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "q", values_to = "code") |>
  mutate(
    service = services[q],
    status = factor(code, levels = c(3, 2, 1),
                    labels = c("Unaware", "Aware but have not used",
                               "Aware and have used"))
  ) |>
  count(service, status) |>
  group_by(service) |>
  mutate(share = n / sum(n)) |>
  ungroup()

used_order <- awareness |>
  filter(status == "Aware and have used") |>
  arrange(share) |>
  pull(service)

ggplot(awareness, aes(x = share, y = factor(service, levels = used_order),
                      fill = status)) +
  geom_col(color = "white") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Unaware" = "grey80",
                               "Aware but have not used" = theme_sand,
                               "Aware and have used" = theme_teal)) +
  labs(x = "Share of members", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

## Row {height="45%"}

### Column {.tabset}

```{r}
#| title: Operations ratings
#| fig-asp: 0.45
ops <- efcu |>
  select(`Rates lower than competitors` = q30, `Keeps information confidential` = q31,
         `Prompt` = q32, `Meets members' needs` = q33,
         `Loan applications simple` = q34) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "item", values_to = "score") |>
  group_by(item) |>
  summarise(mean = mean(score))

ggplot(ops, aes(x = mean, y = fct_reorder(item, mean))) +
  geom_col(fill = theme_coral, width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = number(mean, 0.01)), hjust = -0.2) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 5), breaks = 1:5) +
  labs(x = "Mean agreement (1-5)", y = NULL)
```

```{r}
#| title: Overall rating
#| fig-asp: 0.45
efcu |>
  filter(!is.na(q37)) |>
  mutate(rating = factor(q37, levels = 1:5,
                         labels = c("Excellent", "Good", "Average",
                                    "Poor", "Very Poor"))) |>
  count(rating, .drop = FALSE) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = rating, y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = theme_teal, width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.4) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Members")
```

### Column

```{r}
#| title: Current loan by residence
efcu |>
  count(residence, loan = if_else(q27 == 1, "Has a CU loan", "No CU loan")) |>
  group_by(residence) |>
  mutate(share = percent(n / sum(n), 1)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  knitr::kable(col.names = c("Residence", "Loan status", "Members", "Share"))
```
